mapper.select: SELECT id, task_type AS taskType, request_json AS requestJson, download_token AS downloadToken FROM export_task WHERE task_status='QUEUED' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE export_task SET task_status='RUNNING', started_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), progress=1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{taskId} AND task_status='QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_status AS taskStatus, file_name AS fileName, file_size AS fileSize, file_reference AS fileReference, download_token AS downloadToken, expires_at AS expiresAt FROM export_task WHERE id=#{taskId}
